opportunities.title: ONMT — conversational AI and BI on Qlik Sense
unknowns: Named Qlik Sense integration reference/attestation (RC PDF p.7)
Named attestable AI-solution reference (RC PDF p.7)
Minimum team CVs (chef projet, IA, BI/Qlik, full-stack) (RC PDF p.8)
20,000 MAD provisional and 3% definitive guarantees (CPS PDF p.6)

Whether Ora bids directly as a foreign entity or via a Moroccan-installed partner: fiscal/CNSS/RCCM pieces apply only at the award-intended stage (RC PDF p.6, Art. 5.I.A.2) and a 15% domestic preference applies (RC PDF p.17, Art. 16)
opportunities.nextAction: Obtain a named Qlik Sense deployment/integration attestation and a named AI-solution attestation (RC PDF p.7) and assemble the four minimum team CVs (RC PDF p.8); note the fiscal (percepteur)/CNSS/RCCM pieces (RC PDF p.6, Art. 5.I.A.2) are due only if award is envisaged, and a foreign bidder is admissible subject to the 15% domestic preference (RC PDF p.17, Art. 16). Budget the 20,000 MAD provisional guarantee (CPS p.6).
opportunities.summary: DCE obtained by the preceding browser task and reviewed locally (dce/RC.txt 26 PDF pages, dce/CPS.txt 24 pages). RC PDF page 5 (Article 4) states participant conditions generally (fiscal regularity, CNSS affiliation, activity in relation to the object) and does NOT single out domestic operators; the fiscal (percepteur du lieu d'imposition) attestation, the CNSS regularity attestation and the RCCM modele 9 are required under Article 5.I.A.2 only from the concurrent to which award is envisaged (pieces listed on RC PDF page 6). RC PDF page 17 (Articles 15-16) sets the dirham as currency and grants a 15% domestic-preference on financial offers for Moroccan-installed competitors; foreign or non-installed competitors remain admissible. No mandatory Moroccan registration/CNSS/fiscal requirement blocks a foreign bidder at offer stage; the earlier wording overstated this. The two Qlik Sense/AI attestations (RC PDF p.7) and four minimum team profiles (RC PDF p.8) are UNKNOWN for Ora, and the 20,000 MAD provisional guarantee (CPS PDF p.6) is unknown, so all requirement verdicts remain UNKNOWN and the decision is needs-information.
opportunities.rationale: Requirements were extracted with real PDF page references and compared to profile facts: all are UNKNOWN. Missing named Qlik and AI attestations alone would cause rejection, so pursue is not justified; nothing was invented and no stage beyond qualification-checked is claimed.

requirements.requirement: At least two attestations: one on the deployment and integration of Qlik Sense in the domain of activity, one on the implementation of an AI solution; missing => offer rejected
requirements.fact: Profile claims AI/chatbot services but lists only anonymized client stories; Qlik Sense never mentioned; no attestations

requirements.requirement: Minimum team profiles: chef de projet (Bac+4, 1 AI + 1 BI project); Expert IA; Expert BI Qlik Sense (1 Qlik project); full-stack dev (web + mobile); missing => rejected
requirements.fact: Profile states no team members, qualifications or project references

requirements.requirement: Administrative capacity: legal, technical and financial capacities and activity in relation to the object (Article 4 participation conditions); the fiscal regularity attestation (percepteur du lieu d'imposition), CNSS regularity attestation and RCCM modele 9 certificate are required under Article 5.I.A.2 only from the concurrent to which award is envisaged, each issued within the last year.
requirements.page: RC PDF pages 5-6 (Article 4 participation conditions p.5; Article 5.I.A.2 fiscal/CNSS/RCCM pieces p.6)
requirements.fact: Profile states no domicile, registration, tax or CNSS status; it is not established that Ora is a Moroccan-installed entity. These administrative pieces are due only at the award-intended stage, not necessarily with a foreign offer.

requirements.requirement: Provisional guarantee of 20,000.00 MAD with the offer; definitive guarantee 3% of contract, unconditional and from an approved Moroccan body
requirements.fact: Profile states no financial guarantees

requirements.requirement: Dossier and technical documents in French only
requirements.fact: Profile site is EN/FR marketing only, not a contractual-language certification
